task_name: ZM3D July 2025 event/lives scheduler outage root cause + remediation workstream
authoring_notes: Process covers confirmed-negative and multi-source verification behaviors that Outcomes cannot prove from the artifact alone. Aligned to 'open if none exists' and discovery-framed Observability/calendar asks. No tool names.

rubrics.criterion: The Agent searches the issue tracker for an existing outage record and for existing remediation tickets before opening the incident record and creating remediation tickets.
rubrics.justification: The prompt says open an incident if one does not already exist and create tickets only for remediations that are genuinely missing; that confirmed-negative search cannot be proven from the artifact alone.
rubrics.evidence: Before creating those tickets, the trajectory shows tracker searches for outage/remediation work.

rubrics.criterion: Agent consults the Live-Ops Event Engine page plus both required cross-check pages (Live-Ops Event Calendar & Planning and Observability & Alerting) before writing the register entry.
rubrics.justification: The prompt requires cross-checking Calendar and Observability so alerting and calendar-safety findings are not judged from a single source; Outcome rubrics score the findings, not whether those pages were actually read.
rubrics.evidence: Trajectory shows reads of the Engine page, the Calendar page, and the Observability page before the final entry.

rubrics.criterion: Agent looks up the Zombie Match 3D Level Changelog sheet (or its spreadsheet) before citing the version columns that bracket the outage window.
rubrics.justification: Sheet corroboration is a required ask; Outcome scores the citation in the register, Process scores that the sheet was looked up first.
rubrics.evidence: Before the register cites the bracketing dates, the trajectory shows a Google Sheets or Drive call targeting spreadsheet f_5880c5ea428803df7d0d50 or the Zombie Match 3D Level Changelog workbook/tab. A bona fide open/list/values call on that spreadsheet before citing passes even if the tool returns empty/404 afterward. Citing the dates with no prior call to that spreadsheet fails.
